title: Logo Folio
eyebrow: Self-initiated concept collection · AI-assisted visual study
headline: Six Brands. Six Stories. Six Unique Identities.
category: Logo Design · Brand Identity · Visual Exploration
summary: A collection of six fictional brand identities exploring distinctive typography, illustrative symbols, visual storytelling, and applications across different industries.
overview: From tactile specialty coffee and botanical skincare to contemporary fashion, hospitality, gourmet food, and experimental digital design, each identity is treated as an independent concept with its own visual language.
processNote: This is a speculative, AI-assisted exploration. The visuals are image-based concept studies, not independently verified client commissions, finalized vector identity systems, or production-ready brand guidelines.

brands.name: brùlè
brands.concept: A tactile coffee identity with expressive serif letterforms and a leaf-and-bean mark, applied across coffee packaging, ceramics, and signage.

brands.name: vèrda
brands.concept: A botanical wellness direction combining an elegant wordmark, leaf symbolism, deep greens, and quiet product photography.

brands.name: nína
brands.concept: A high-contrast fashion wordmark with unexpected accents, expressive editorial typography, and tactile labels and accessories.

brands.name: lùmora
brands.concept: A destination-led hospitality identity featuring a stylized horizon motif, refined typography, and atmospheric coastal imagery.

brands.name: tála
brands.concept: An expressive food identity driven by a hand-drawn-style wordmark, lively red and orange tones, and an illustrated tomato mark.

brands.name: pixel drift
brands.concept: A modern digital identity mixing chunky contemporary typography, luminous gradients, and a fluid abstract graphic symbol.
